name: Miyada (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miyada village emblem in orange: a stylised swirl of curved strokes, like a crescent.
history: Municipal flag of Miyada, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1975.

features.role: Miyada village emblem — a stylised swirl of curved strokes, like a crescent
